utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, Dane. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing, Mara. I just need help with a loose hinge on the back gate and a flickering porch light.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Dane. I’ll take the gate hinge first and then check the porch light next.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I can help with that. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure - can you tell me which part is acting up?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The dryer belt is the part acting up. I can take a look this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got some spare tape and a box of screws if the drive needs it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good, I probably have some tape around here too. Thanks, Cleo - let’s see what the drive actually needs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Let’s check the drive first, then I can hand over the tape or screws if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that repair drive. Just tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks. Can you let me know when you can come by, and what parts you need me to have ready?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can come by tomorrow afternoon. Please have the replacement parts and the tool list ready, and I’ll confirm the exact time earlier in the day.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it’s starting soon, but I don’t know the exact time yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we know whether it starts in the morning or later?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up speed again. Folks are talking about it all over the block.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure is. I’ve got a couple of tools set aside if anyone needs a hand with the fixes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a real help, Gus. I’ll spread the word so folks know there’s a hand on deck.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together a quick invite list for the repair drive. Want me to add you to the neighbor notice too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please add me to the neighbor notice.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ve got you on the neighbor notice.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Kira. Tell me what still needs fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the drive itself, right? I still need to know what’s left to fix.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, the drive itself. I still need to know which repairs are left so I can help finish them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive on my list, Bo. Tell me which house needs help first, and I’ll line up the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start with the Miller place on Oak Street, and I can help round up a few people for it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it, I’ll put the Miller place first and line up the volunteers for Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Tell Eli I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Come by after lunch, and I’ll have the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll come by after lunch and be ready when the list’s set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive — I meant to bring something by. Let me check my notes and I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No rush. I appreciate you checking—just let me know when you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, I’ll check my notes and bring something by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. Need a hand with anything for it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s shaping up, yeah. I could use a hand moving a few boxes and maybe sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help move boxes and sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting the word out now, Dane. If you want, I can bring a few neighbors by to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great. I’ll join as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word and swing back with a few neighbors soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is happening soon. I can help if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be a big help, Rey. I’ll keep it simple and make a clear list so we know what to do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll wait for the list and help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that, but I need to check the school pickup window first so I don't miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, just let me know once you’ve checked the pickup window and I’ll keep the repair drive on my end moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I just checked it, and I’m clear on pickup now, so you can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need the tools and a quick check of what’s already been assigned. I can repeat the plan and keep people posted as we go.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, that covers the main gap. Send me the assigned list when you can, and I’ll help keep track of the tools and next steps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll see what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, but I need to know what parts you can bring so I can plan the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a basic tool kit with a screwdriver, wrench, pliers, and a tape measure so you can plan around the rest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where the kits are if you point me to the repair drive drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Opal. The repair drive drop-off is by the community center entrance, and I’ll make sure the kits are clearly marked there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll head to the community center entrance and watch for the clearly marked kits.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When do you need it by, and what’s left to fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I need it by Friday, and the main things left are the wiring and one loose hinge.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help with that. Do you want me to focus on the wiring first or the hinge?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Cleo. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll see what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I still need a quick count of the boards, screws, and tarps before we start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do that, Cleo. I’ll count the boards, screws, and tarps now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s been a lot of updates about it, but I’m not sure what’s actually decided yet. What have you heard from Noah?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I heard they’re still sorting it out. I’m not sure what’s settled yet, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, same here. I’m just waiting to hear what’s actually settled before I believe any of it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive for the whole neighborhood, right? I just want to make sure that's actually what Tess is talking about.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, the neighborhood repair drive. I just wanted to make sure we’re talking about the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's moving along; I can swing by after errands if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I might take you up on that if I get stuck.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Appreciate it, Uli. I’ll check back after my errands and see where you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Leo — I may have misplaced the details, but I’m here to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tell me what materials you need, and I’ll handle the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I just need tape, a couple of replacement outlet covers, and one small box of screws for the broken latch.
